newsitem.title: FRANCE: French analysts raise CAC-40 forecasts.
newsitem.headline: French analysts raise CAC-40 forecasts.

text.p: French financial analysts have increased their forecasts for the CAC-40 blue-chip index but their three-month estimate is at about current market levels, newspaper Agefi said.
Having polled 17 brokerages and banks, Agefi said that the average three-month forecast was standing at 2,317.69 in early December against 2,183.70 in November.
The forecast for the one-year period was raised to an average of 2,402.86 from 2,315.49.
On Friday, the CAC-40 closed at 2,215.66.
